pricingPhilosophy: Price on value delivered, not cost-plus. The office furniture decision is not a commodity purchase — it is a brand and culture investment for the client. Premium pricing is justified when the service experience, certainty, and quality are visibly superior.

executiveDesks.note: GOJO Vol 2 from $2,500 — position as investment-grade

sitStandDesks.note: Dual-motor > single-motor — always present the premium spec first

additionalRevenueItems.deliveryAndInstallation: 12–25% of product value — always include on managed projects
additionalRevenueItems.furnitureDisposal: $500–$3,000 depending on volume and building access difficulty
additionalRevenueItems.stagingAndPhasing: Add 15% to logistics cost for phased multi-stage delivery
additionalRevenueItems.rushDelivery: 15–25% premium for confirmed sub-6-week delivery from in-stock items

gstRule.statement: Always quote ex-GST. Clearly state GST will be added in invoice. Never quote inc-GST unless requested.

importCostComponents.freightAndInsurance: 15–22% on top of product cost for sea freight + insurance
importCostComponents.importDuty: 5% on CIF value for most furniture
importCostComponents.totalLandedCostMultiplier: Add 25–35% to supplier FOB price to estimate landed warehouse cost
